Hey, isn't it hard to walk in and out of here every time? For just ^0000ff20,000^000000 Zeny, you can have a scroll that will take you directly to the entrance of the ruins, what do you think?

scripts.text: Give me one

scripts.text: I don't think so

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[神器強化師]
強化過程中裝備不會損壞，但重置強化時裝備有很高的機率會損壞。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
